title: Sugarcane Farmers' Protest Disrupts NH-48; Government Sets Up Committee
summary:
Protests by sugarcane farmers in Karnataka disrupted traffic on the Pune–Bengaluru National Highway 48, leaving commuters and transport operators facing delays and diversions. Farmers are demanding better prices for sugarcane and action on related pricing issues.
On October 14, the government also announced a committee led by former NITI Aayog member Ramesh Chand to examine farmers' demands, including remunerative sugarcane prices and the minimum selling price of sugar. The developments highlight continuing tensions over agricultural pricing and the financial concerns of sugarcane growers.
